notes: Lord of each house placed in each house (verses 1-144). Verses 145-148 say these results scale with the lord's strength, and that a planet ruling two houses gives the results of both: contradictory results cancel, differing ones both apply.

skipped.reason: Only concerns mortality of children (excluded by the sensitive-topics policy).

rules.text: Good physical comfort and bodily strength; a thoughtful, intelligent but changeable mind. More than one marriage or attachment is indicated.
Gainful and learned; happy, good-natured, principled and respected, with many good qualities.
Great courage, wealth of many kinds, honour, intelligence and happiness. More than one marriage is indicated.
Happiness from both parents and from siblings; attractive and virtuous, with a strongly sensual nature.
Only moderate happiness through children; honourable but quick to anger, and favoured by those in authority.
Bodily comfort and ease are reduced.

variants.text: With a malefic influencing the ascendant lord and no benefic aspect on it, there is trouble from opponents.
With a malefic ascendant lord in the 7th, married life faces difficulty.
With a benefic ascendant lord in the 7th, the person tends to wander without a settled aim and lean towards detachment and simple means — or, at the other extreme, rise to high position.

rules.text: Aptitude for occult and hidden knowledge; a hot temper, a taste for gambling and risk, and a pull towards secretive or illicit dealings and affairs.
Fortunate and well liked; devout, skilful and an eloquent speaker; blessed with spouse, children and wealth.
Happiness from the father, favour from authority, a good public name and wealth earned by one's own effort.
Steady gains, good qualities and fame. More than one marriage or relationship is indicated.
Bodily comfort is reduced.

variants.text: With no benefic in or aspecting the 12th house, money is spent unproductively and the temper is short.

rules.text: Blessed with children and wealth, but at odds with one's own family; passionate, hard-hearted and inclined to work for others.
Wealthy and proud; more than one marriage is indicated, with obstacles in the matter of children.

variants.text: With the 2nd lord linked to a benefic: courageous, wise and virtuous, though passionate and tight-fisted.
With the 2nd lord linked to a malefic: an unorthodox, contrarian outlook.

rules.text: Wealth of every kind.

variants.text: With the 2nd lord joined by Jupiter or exalted, the standing rivals that of a ruler.

rules.text: Wealthy; the children are also intent on earning.

variants.text: With the 2nd lord joined by a benefic, money is gained through rivals and competitors.
With the 2nd lord joined by a malefic, there are losses through rivals and opponents.

rules.text: Attraction to relationships outside marriage; aptitude for the healing professions.

variants.text: With a malefic joining or aspecting the 2nd lord, fidelity within the marriage is a point of strain.

rules.text: Abundant land and property, but little happiness in marriage and little joy from an elder sibling.
Wealthy, hard-working and skilful. Childhood is the less comfortable period, with happiness afterwards; visits to holy places and observance of religious practice.
Honourable and learned, with strong desires; more than one marriage is indicated, and less happiness through children.
Wealth and gains of all kinds; always industrious, honourable and well known.
Adventurous but short of money and dependent on others; less happiness from the eldest child.
Self-made wealth; service-minded, brave and intelligent, though with little formal learning.
A heavy build, low drive and little initiative; unhappy, and covetous of what belongs to others.
Happiness through siblings; wealthy, blessed with children, cheerful and very content.
Happy, wealthy and intelligent, but with a difficult-natured spouse.
Blessed with children and personal merit.

variants.text: With a malefic joining or aspecting the 3rd lord, the spouse has a harsh temperament.

rules.text: At odds with a sibling and with the maternal uncle, yet very wealthy and fond of the maternal aunt.
Suited to serving government or those in authority. Early life is not happy, but happiness comes in the later part of life.
Livelihood through serving others; a temptation to take what is not one's own, and a risk of trouble with the authorities.
Less happiness from the father; fortune comes through the spouse, with joy from children.
Happiness of all kinds and self-made wealth; a tendency to support people of doubtful character.
Consistent gains in trade; sharp even without formal education, adventurous and working in the service of others.
Money is spent on unworthy things and the father is stern, but fortune comes through the spouse.
Blessed with learning, good qualities, ornaments, land, vehicles and happiness from the mother.
Enjoyment of pleasures, wealth of all kinds, family life and honour; adventurous, with a shrewd and calculating streak.
Courageous, generous, virtuous and charitable; has people working under them, earns wealth independently and enjoys good health.
Rises to a senior advisory or ministerial position; wealthy, skilful, virtuous, honoured, learned, happy and on good terms with the spouse.
Happy and liked by all; devout, virtuous and honourable, with self-earned wealth.
Little happiness from the mother; quick to anger, self-willed, and prone to dishonest or questionable conduct.
Highly learned in several branches of knowledge; inclined to give up ancestral property, and tongue-tied in a gathering.
Little domestic comfort and little happiness from the parents; reduced vigour.
Loved by all; devoted to God, virtuous, honourable and blessed with every kind of happiness.
Honours from government or authority; skill in chemistry or similar transforming crafts; contented, enjoying pleasures yet in command of the senses.
Generous, virtuous, charitable and helpful to others, though given to private worry about health.
Little domestic comfort; a tendency to bad habits, poor judgement and laziness.
Scholarly and happy through children, but tight-fisted, devious and covetous of others' wealth.
Many children and wealth; a supporter of the family, honourable, attached to the spouse and well known.
Dear to the siblings; a carrier of gossip, tight-fisted and absorbed in one's own work.
Happy; blessed with a mother's care, wealth and intelligence; rises to be a leader, adviser or teacher.

variants.text: With the 5th lord in the 5th joined by a benefic, the person is blessed with children.
With the 5th lord in the 5th joined by a malefic, children are delayed or denied, though the person is virtuous and dear to friends.

rules.text: Strained relations with one's children, or a child comes through adoption.
Deeply religious and tolerant of all faiths; happy through children and helpful to others.
Less happiness through children; irritable and lacking contentment.
Status like that of a prince; a distinguished author and the pride of the family.
A raja yoga: favour from government and authority, varied pleasures and great distinction.
Learned, popular and very skilful; a distinguished author, with many children and wealth.
Little happiness from children of one's own; a child may come through adoption.
Health needs care; well known, adventurous and virtuous, but at odds with relatives.
Adventurous and distinguished within the family; lives abroad or far from the birthplace; happy, a good speaker and absorbed in one's own work.
Short-tempered and lacking courage; at odds with siblings, and poorly served by subordinates.
Little happiness from the mother; intelligent and very rich, but gossiping, jealous and changeable.
Finances keep fluctuating; friction with children and friends; nevertheless happy, self-interested and kind.
At odds with one's own relatives while friendly with outsiders; only middling results in matters such as wealth.
Little happiness through marriage, yet famous, virtuous, honourable, adventurous and wealthy.
Health needs care; hostile to learned people and covetous of what belongs to others.
Trade in timber, stone or similar materials, with ups and downs in business.
Distinguished within the family and a gifted speaker; not close to the father; happy living abroad.
Gains through rivals or opponents; virtuous, adventurous and honourable, but with less happiness through children.
Money is spent on bad habits; hostile to learned people and unkind to animals.
Drawn to relationships outside marriage; clever but lacking steadiness and principle.
More than one marriage or relationship is indicated; wealth comes through the spouse; a tendency to procrastinate.
The spouse is strongly independent and goes their own way; the person is truthful, intelligent and religious.
Honourable and gifted with every good quality; always cheerful and possessing wealth of all kinds.
Friction with the spouse, whose health needs care; short-tempered and lacking contentment.
Happiness through the spouse; courageous, skilful and intelligent.
Little happiness in marriage; the spouse's health needs care, and the couple are often at cross purposes.
Several relationships are indicated, though the person is well disposed to the spouse; takes the initiative in many undertakings.
The spouse is strongly independent; the person is religious and gifted with wealth and children.
Wealth comes through the spouse; less happiness from sons, with more daughters than sons.
Limited means and a tight hand with money, while the spouse spends freely; livelihood through textiles, clothing or similar trade.
Bodily comfort is reduced and the body is prone to injury; an irreverent attitude to religion and its teachers.
Low physical vigour and modest wealth; money once lost is hard to recover.
Little happiness from siblings; low energy and drive, and little help from subordinates.
Separation or distance from the mother; difficulty holding on to a home, land and contentment; friendships are not kept faithfully.
A slow or dull intellect and few children, but wealthy.
Wins over opponents, though health needs care; caution around water and snakes in childhood.
Two marriages are indicated.

variants.text: With a malefic joining the 8th lord, losses in trade or business are certain.

rules.text: With a weak 8th lord in the 8th: a tendency to dishonesty, drawing blame and blaming others in turn.
Turns away from the family's religion and holds unorthodox views; a difficult-natured spouse; covets others' wealth.
Little happiness from the father, a tendency to gossip, and interruptions to livelihood.

variants.text: A benefic aspects the 8th lord, so these difficulties do not fully materialise.

rules.text: Short of money and unhappy in childhood, but happy in later life.
Money is wasted on unworthy things, more so when a malefic joins the 8th lord.
Fortunate and prosperous; honoured by government and by the public; good-natured and charming.
Learned, popular and wealthy, with strong desires; happy through spouse and children.
Happiness from siblings; wealthy, virtuous and charming.
The comfort of houses and vehicles, wealth of all kinds, and devotion to the mother.
Blessed with children and good fortune; devoted to elders and teachers; steady, religious, charitable and learned.
Fortune is reduced; little help from maternal relatives, and trouble from opponents.
Happiness through the spouse; virtuous and well known.
Fortune is held back, with little happiness from an elder sibling.
Abundant good fortune; virtuous and good-looking, with happiness from siblings.
Rises to the top rank — a ruler, minister or commander in the text's terms; virtuous and widely respected.
Financial gains grow day by day; devoted to teachers, virtuous and charitable.
Fortune drains away through generosity: money is spent on worthy causes and on hospitality to the point of straining one's means.
Learned, famous and poetic; a less robust childhood followed by happiness, with wealth increasing steadily.
Wealthy, virtuous and charitable; honoured by government; happiness from the father.
Happiness from siblings and from those who work for the person; brave, virtuous, eloquent and truthful.
Happy and devoted to the mother's welfare; owns vehicles, land and houses; virtuous and wealthy.
Learning of every kind; always cheerful, wealthy and blessed with children.
Despite real skill: little happiness from the father, limited wealth and trouble from opponents.
Happiness through the spouse; intelligent, virtuous, eloquent, truthful and devoted to religion.
Few praiseworthy deeds to one's name, and a habit of finding fault with others.
Rises to a commanding position — a ruler if born to it, otherwise the equal of one; wealth and happiness through children.
Skilful in every kind of work; brave, truthful and devoted to teachers and elders.
Blessed with wealth and children; happy, truthful, cheerful and virtuous.
Money goes on dealings with courts and officialdom; fear of opponents, and worry despite real skill.
A pure (sattvic) nature; rich, happy, even-handed, poetic and eloquent, with gains always coming in.
Wealth and accomplishments of every kind; charitable, religious and always happy.
Skilful in every kind of work, wealthy, and happy through siblings.
Gains from the mother's side of the family, pilgrimages, and the comfort of house and land.
The children are happy, educated and virtuous; the person is religious and content.
Health generally needs care; a harsh streak, residence abroad, and trouble from opponents.
Regular gains through the spouse's family; generous, virtuous and sensual, and guided by the spouse's wishes.
Losses or setbacks in undertakings.
Fortunate, skilful, truthful and wealthy; honoured by those in authority.
Honoured by those in authority; virtuous, truthful, devoted to their religion and self-controlled.
Gains in every undertaking; learning and happiness increase day by day.
Spends consistently on good causes; sensual, with more than one relationship indicated, and friendships with foreigners.
A free spender with a less robust constitution; limited wealth and learning.
Spends on worthy causes; religious and sweet-spoken, with good qualities and happiness.
Little happiness from siblings; dislike of other people and a self-centred outlook.
Little happiness from the mother, and recurring losses in land, vehicles and housing.
Obstacles in the matter of children and learning; money is spent and pilgrimages made in the hope of a child.
Conflict with one's own people; short-tempered and unhappy, and drawn to relationships outside marriage.
Constant expense on account of the spouse and little happiness in marriage; limited learning and strength.
Gains keep coming; pleasant in speech and endowed with good qualities.
Disrespect for teachers, friction even with friends, and a single-minded focus on one's own ends.
Rises through people in government or authority; only moderate happiness from the father.
Losses even where the chart otherwise promises gain; occasional small gains through other people's money.
Heavy expenditure, reduced physical ease, and an irritable, resentful temper.
